📦 **Open-Source Repository:**
👉 https://github.com/VoiceStudio/VoiceStudio

⚡ **Quickstart Local Install (CPU/GPU):**
```bash
git clone https://github.com/VoiceStudio/VoiceStudio
cd VoiceStudio && pip install -r requirements.txt
python -m voicestudio.cli --model kokoro-82m
```

🎙️ **Features Included:**
• Kokoro-82M real-time CPU synthesis (120 WPM)
• Neural zero-shot voice cloning with 5s reference audio
• Claude Code API bridge for auto-script voicing

Are you looking to clone your own voice or build automated faceless videos?

Smart choice. For clean personal voice cloning:
1. Record 15 seconds of clean speech with zero background noise
2. Run `python -m voicestudio.clone --ref my_sample.wav`
3. It outputs a reusable voice profile (.bin) you can call anytime!

Want our custom FFmpeg broadcast mastering filter preset that makes cheap laptop mics sound like a $400 Shure SM7B?

That's exactly what we run at Signhify Studio! We pipe Claude video scripts directly into Kokoro ONNX, generating broadcast-ready voiceovers in 4 seconds flat.

Want our Claude Code prompt that formats scripts with exact pause cues and emotion tags?

Here is the production audio mastering chain:

```bash
ffmpeg -i input.wav -af "highpass=f=80,equalizer=f=160:t=q:w=1.2:g=2.5,equalizer=f=3200:t=q:w=1.5:g=2.0,acompressor=threshold=-16dB:ratio=3.5:attack=15:release=120,loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=10" -ar 44100 mastered.wav
```
